title: Rattlesnake tongue and hold

source.why_this_clip: A coiled rattlesnake sits large in side view on a rock with its head raised and rattle held up, shifting its head and flicking its tongue. No cut is detected, but a dissolve from an eye close-up ends at about 10.5 s, so the interval starts at 10.75 s and runs to the end of the clip.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected sixteen raw source frames across the provisional event in preflight-source.jpg; no cut/dissolve observed inside retained interval. Normal-speed playback unrun.
